name: Unchained Rogue Dark Dancer
body:
Some rogues don’t simply skulk through shadows, they become them by embracing their potential as denizens of the dark.

Shadow Sneak (Ex)

A dark dancer can make sneak attacks against creatures benefiting from concealment, including total concealment, if the target and the dark dancer both have concealment from the same source, such as both being in a dark room.

This ability alters sneak attack.

Dancing in the Dark (Ex)

Dark dancers gain a bonus to Acrobatics and Perform (dance) checks equal to 1/2 their class level.

This ability replaces trapfinding.

Shadowed Footsteps (Su)

Beginning at 3rd level, a dark dancer can make a Perform (dance) check to pass through a space occupied by another creature as long as there is an area of shadow adjacent to that creature (whether its own shadow or one cast by a nearby object or creature). The DC for this check is the creature’s CMD. On a success, the dark dancer gains 20% concealment against any attack of opportunity incurred as they are briefly wrapped in shadow.

This ability replaces danger sense and its improvements.

Shadow Dance (Su)

Beginning at 4th level, the dark dancer can travel between shadows as easily as doorways. As a standard action the dark dancer may teleport from one shadow (which must be roughly half the size of the dark dancer) to another shadow within 30 feet plus an additional 5 feet for every two class levels.

This ability replaces uncanny dodge.

Shadow Stabbing (Ex)

Beginning at 8th level, whenever the dark dancer appears adjacent to a creature when using their shadow dance ability they may make a melee attack against that creature as a swift action, if that attack hits it is considered to meet the requirements for a sneak attack.

This ability replaces improved uncanny dodge.
